FRIDAY FIX: send your customers a thank-you before Christmas.

It might be the simplest, most memorable marketing you do all year.

1. Pull your customer list from your CRM
2. Write a short, personal note. No pitch, no coupon.

4. Send it before Dec 23, while inboxes are still calm

People remember how you made them feel, and a thank-you with no ask stands out in a December inbox full of sales.
